privileged_info_for_vlm: The target Semi-Major Axis (SMA) is 3796.19 km (Mars radius 3396.19 + 400 km altitude). The correct Sun-Synchronous inclination for this altitude at Mars is approximately 92.9 degrees (acceptable range 92.8 to 93.0). The propagation must be 60 Earth days. The gravity model must be Mars50c. Output files must be in ~/Documents/missions/mars_sso.script and ~/GMAT_output/mars_sso_report.txt.
